entry_surfaces./: split hero — brand identity & quick reservation left with instant availability check, catalog highlight showcase & active equipment cards right
entry_surfaces./login: branded split auth — Lany Infláveis festive background & positioning panel left, secure login form with role switcher right
entry_surfaces./register: branded split auth — positioning panel with customer benefits left, registration form (CPF, WhatsApp, Address) right
entry_surfaces./admin: high-density ERP dashboard — key performance metrics grid top, real-time dispatch and bookings calendar center, PIX financial overview bottom
entry_surfaces./checkout/:id: crystal PIX transaction panel — countdown timer, QR code graphic, instant copia-e-cola string, and real-time webhook status badge

grids.dashboard_mode: MODE B: High Density Grid (col-span-1 for summary KPIs, col-span-2 or 3 for booking timeline, col-span-1 for quick actions and equipment status)
grids.catalog_mode: Responsive Tetris Grid (1 col mobile, 2 col tablet, 3-4 col desktop) with high-impact product cards, dimension badges, age group chips, and instant rent buttons
grids.spacing_scale: p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-8 with gap-4 md:gap-6 for dashboard widgets; gap-8 for public storefront

visual_enhancers.card_style: Solid white or slate-800 with 1px border (border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/60), nested radius rounded-2xl, soft ambient shadow (shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow)
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used selectively for sticky top navigation bar (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80 border-b border-slate-200/80 dark:border-slate-800)
visual_enhancers.pix_badge: Vibrant emerald green badge with pulse animation when payment is pending, solid green checkmark upon Mercado Pago webhook confirmation
visual_enhancers.contract_signature_pad: Clean digital signature box with canvas drawing + one-click digital certificate timestamp and terms acceptance checkbox
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Playful and descriptive Brazilian Portuguese copy with contextual action buttons ('Nenhuma reserva encontrada - Criar Novo Agendamento')

motion.transitions: transition: color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease
motion.enter_animation: framer-motion staggered fade-in + slide-up for lists and metric cards
motion.modal_animation: scale-up from 95% to 100% with backdrop opacity fade
motion.accessibility_reduced_motion: Wrap animations with prefers-reduced-motion media query checks or fallback to instantaneous visibility

accessibility.wcag_target: WCAG AA (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large display headers and buttons)
accessibility.data_testids: MANDATORY on all buttons, links, inputs, selects, tabs, status badges, and metric cards (e.g. data-testid='pix-copy-button', data-testid='btn-create-booking', data-testid='input-customer-cpf')
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Visible ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2 on all interactive focus targets

Gestão de Reservas & Ciclo de Vida
Cadastro de Brinquedos, Dimensões e Manutenção
Configurações da Empresa, Mercado Pago e Usuários

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Adotar pt-BR estritamente em toda a interface: moedas formatadas em 'R$ 1.250,00', datas 'DD/MM/AAAA' e horários em formato 24h.
2. Identidade visual da Lany Infláveis: vibrante, alegre e acolhedora para festas infantis, porém sóbria e altamente profissional no painel administrativo.

3. Fluxo de pagamento PIX exclusivo: simulação realista integrada com Mercado Pago (geração de QR Code Base64/SVG, código copia-e-cola com feedback de cópia, polling/webhook em tempo real para confirmação automática de reserva).
4. Sistema de conflito de agenda inteligente: impedir dupla reserva do mesmo brinquedo no mesmo dia/faixa de horário.
5. Geração automática de contrato com cláusulas padrão brasileiras de locação de brinquedos (responsabilidade, cuidados elétricos, cancelamento) e área para aceite/assinatura digital do cliente.
6. Integração e log de mensagens WhatsApp (notificação de pré-reserva, envio de chave PIX, confirmação de pagamento e link de assinatura do contrato) com botão de envio rápido via link wa.me.
7. Controle de permissões RBAC robusto: Administrador (acesso total), Funcionário (agenda, reservas, brinquedos, entregas) e Cliente (portal isolado).
8. Todos os elementos interativos DEVEM conter data-testid descritivos.
9. Suporte nativo ao modo escuro (dark mode toggle) respeitando o design system.

do_not: DO NOT use emojis as system UI icons (use Lucide icons like Calendar, DollarSign, Shield, CheckCircle, Package, Users, Truck, Clock).
DO NOT use generic unformatted numbers for currency (always use Intl.NumberFormat pt-BR).
DO NOT center-align the main app layout text globally.
DO NOT apply transition: all globally.
DO NOT use pure black #000000 or harsh pure gray #808080.
do: Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8, p-12) for dashboard panels.
Ensure all buttons have responsive touch targets and active state feedback.
Provide instant toast notifications via Sonner for actions (reserva criada, pix copiado, contrato assinado, status atualizado).
Pre-seed realistic data for Lany Infláveis (Pula-Pula Castelo 3x3m, Tobogã Inflável 5m, Cama Elástica 3.05m, Futebol de Sabão 8x4m, Piscina de Bolinhas, Pipoca & Algodão Doce).
